{{Top|leg}}
A '''holoposter''' was a poster portrayed by [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] means, usually for advertising purposes.<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> 

They were a form of public media used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They distributed holo-posters containing the [[textfile]] of a declaration that the Empire was victorious on all fronts, and that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] accusations of atrocities were lies and fabrications.<ref name="if" />
